results.name: beauty rule 'no squashed text' (TT29): under the default slanted camera every visible Tabletop text renders at an effective ≥ 9 px (font-size × projected scale, measured per element) at 1440×900 and 390×800; walls below the legibility rule show glyphs only

wall tags (TT29): one per foreshortened wall, inside the frame, centred on the wall's VISIBLE area (hit-test finds that wall under the centre), ≥ 24 px targets, no overlaps with each other or the switcher; counts in the label

wall tags are the click AND drop targets the slivers could not be (TT29): clicking the Apps spine opens the Apps wall; dragging a floor card onto the Widgets spine highlights it and pins the card there (persisted)

straight-down camera obeys the same rule: its walls are below the legibility scale too (computed), so they show glyphs + tags; no visible text under 9 px effective; the computed box model matches the DOM (each wall face's measured box = its quad's box ± 2 px)
